name: Kupala
source:
“Kupala” is a dark, non-linear horror visual novel inspired by Slavic folklore.

Little Anya arrives at a village on the eve of Kupala Night — the sacred night of the ancient Slavs. In the quiet old house, her grandmother tells her tales of unclean spirits crossing into the living world...

Full game and free demo available on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4037300/Kupala/
translation:
《库帕拉》（Kupala）是一款灵感源自斯拉夫民间传说的黑暗非线性恐怖视觉小说。

小安雅在古斯拉夫人神圣的“库帕拉之夜”前夕来到了一座村庄。在静谧的老屋里，祖母向她娓娓道来那些不洁邪灵跨入生者世界的传说……

完整版游戏与免费试玩版现已登陆Steam：
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4037300/Kupala/
